interpretation.noDedicatedButton: TapNow canvas has NO separate "生成" (generate) button. The only way to trigger AI processing is via the chat input (Enter key or arrow-up send button).
interpretation.fastResponse: Response latency = 1s for the default welcome (likely a canned response). For real generation, latency would be higher (image gen typically 3-10s, video 30s+).
interpretation.noLoadingSpinner: During the 1s response, no spinner/thinking dots appeared. TapNow shows the user message immediately, then the assistant message appears with 300ms opacity transition.
interpretation.quotaImpact: Sending 'test' triggered 1 chat request to backend but did NOT consume image generation quota (the response was a text-only welcome message).
interpretation.transition: 300ms opacity transition for new message bubbles (`transition-opacity duration-300`).
interpretation.v2_correction: V2 §10.9 documented 'Gemini 3.7 Flash' model selector could not open dropdown. V3 confirms: same behavior, model selector button does not respond to click (it's a display element, not a dropdown trigger). The real model selection must be in another location.
